messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "people who have been taking 100 mg or 125 mg of another sertraline product for at least a week and need a higher dose"
set: ["people who have been taking 100 mg or 125 mg of another sertraline product for at least a week and need a higher dose", "someone taking 100 mg or 125 mg of another sertraline product for at least a week", "Treatment-resistant depression for adults who have not responded to at least two adequate antidepressant trials", "7.5 mg to 40 mg a day is moderate", "people at high risk for diabetes", "under 7.5 mg a day is low", "people who are suicidal or prone to addiction", "those who have thyroid problems", "those who have kidney problems", "effect seen at higher doses", "patients taking higher than recommended doses", "close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain", "higher doses of Rosuvastatin", "1.5 mg dose is intended for treatment initiation", "60 mg dose was effective for bulimia nervosa", "starting heart failure treatment if a dose below 25 mg is needed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
